info.title: GULA Platform
info.description:
**GULA** - منصة غولا الصحية الذكية للمختبرات

Smart Health Platform for Medical Laboratories in Iraq.

**Authentication:** Use `Bearer <token>` header (obtain token from `POST /login`).

**Mobile:** Refresh tokens available via `POST /auth/refresh`.

**Version:** 2.5.0

license.name: Proprietary - Ministry of Health Iraq Compliant

post.description:
Logout with two-layer revocation:
1. Redis JTI blacklist — fast, rejects this specific token within milliseconds
2. DB perm_version bump — survives Redis restart; invalidates ALL sessions for this user

Lab admin adds a new staff member to their lab.

Only users with role 'admin' may call this endpoint.
The new account is immediately active — no approval required since the
lab admin is already verified.

Doctor self-registration (no auth required).

Creates a User with role='doctor', is_active=True, is_verified=False.
A ministry or province admin must verify the account before the doctor
can access sensitive endpoints. The doctor's medical license number is
stored in plain text (public document) while the national ID is hashed.

get.description:
Return platform setup state.

Response:
    needs_setup: true  — no users exist yet, show registration wizard
    needs_setup: false — at least one user exists, show normal login

In production: always returns needs_setup=false to prevent information
disclosure about deployment state to unauthenticated callers.

Return operational metrics for the monitoring dashboard.

Scope:
- master_admin / ministry_admin / province_admin: platform-wide numbers
- Everyone else: scoped to their lab_id

Return all patients sharing the same civil-registry family number.

The family_id is hashed before lookup — the raw number is never stored.
Useful for viewing a patient's family health history side by side.

Return all minor patients (children) whose guardian is this patient.

Allows lab staff to view the full paediatric history of a guardian's
dependents from a single screen.
List available composite test profiles (CBC, Lipid, etc.).

post.description:
Validate and lock an order.  Only admin/master_admin/doctor may do this.
After validation the order is immutable — results cannot be deleted or edited.

Race-condition protection: uses an atomic UPDATE WHERE locked_at IS NULL
so that two simultaneous validation requests cannot both succeed.
Cancel an order.  Validated (locked) orders cannot be cancelled.

get.description: Get complete test history for a patient (authenticated, lab-scoped).

Get patient test history by phone number (public, rate limited).
Requires 'name' query param matching full patient name as verification.

Multi-tenant isolation: the phone number may belong to Patient records in
multiple labs (each lab keeps its own patient roster).  We aggregate results
across ALL labs where the phone+name pair matches, so the citizen sees their
complete history regardless of which lab they visited.  Only the patient's
own results are returned — no cross-patient data is possible.

post.description:
Analyze a batch of results for multi-test clinical patterns.

post.description:
Create a single test result for a citizen (identified by health_id).

- Verifies the patient exists in the caller's lab.
- Auto-generates a sample barcode (a fresh Sample row per order).
- Runs smart_analysis via the interpretation + critical-value engine.
- Emits RESULT_CRITICAL when the value is critically abnormal.
Pre-save sanity check: returns warnings without persisting anything.

get.description: Fetch a single result — lab-scoped (and doctor-scoped for doctors).

put.description:
Mark a result as verified. Triggers validation (lock) of the parent order.

Only admin / master_admin / doctor may verify.  The verification is atomic
(UPDATE ... WHERE locked_at IS NULL) so two concurrent callers cannot
double-verify.

get.description:
Returns aggregate lab statistics in DHIS2-compatible format.
إحصائيات المختبر التجميعية بتنسيق DHIS2.

DHIS2 (District Health Information Software 2) is used by Iraq's Ministry
of Health across 1,848 health institutions for national health reporting.
This endpoint exports non-patient-identifying aggregate counts suitable
for submission to the MoH DHIS2 national health information system.

Data exported: total tests by type, result flag distribution, monthly counts.
No patient PII is included in this response.

Verifies the cryptographic hash chain of audit log records.
التحقق من سلامة سلسلة تجزئة سجل التدقيق.

Each audit log entry contains SHA-256(prev_hash + record_data).
Any tampering with a record or deletion of records breaks the chain.

- Returns `"intact"` if no tampering detected
- Returns `"tampered"` with details of which records were modified
- Returns the last verified hash for external storage/verification

**Access:** admin or master_admin only

get.description:
Admin queue of identity claims awaiting adjudication.

These are matches where the probabilistic score landed in the fuzzy band
(THRESHOLD_REVIEW ≤ score < THRESHOLD_AUTO). Leaving them unreviewed
either loses cross-lab linkage (false negative) or conflates two real
people (false positive, catastrophic at national scale).

post.description:
Confirm or reject an ambiguous claim.

confirm → match_method becomes 'manual' (audit-preserved), the claim stays.
reject  → detach from the current citizen and mint a new canonical one,
          so the lab patient gets its own record. Writes a MergeAudit row
          so the decision is hash-chained.

get.description:

get.description:
Liveness probe — always returns 200 if the process is alive.
Includes circuit breaker state and pool info for observability.

Hybrid readiness probe — startup completed AND services still alive.

Returns 200 only when:
  1. Startup guard completed successfully (all steps passed), AND
  2. Database is currently reachable, AND
  3. Redis cache is currently reachable.

If DB or Redis fail after startup, this probe turns 503 again — the
Docker healthcheck will detect it and trigger a container restart.
Kubernetes-style liveness probe - always returns 200 if process is alive.

Full diagnostic status — shows exactly why the system is or isn't ready.
Useful for debugging startup failures without needing server access.
Always returns 200 — check 'ready' field for actual state.

Deep diagnostic endpoint — comprehensive latency + queue + memory snapshot.
Designed for monitoring dashboards and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).

Returns overall health grade:
  GREEN   — all components healthy, latencies normal
  YELLOW  — degraded performance, some components slow
  RED     — one or more critical components failing

Always returns HTTP 200 — check 'grade' field for actual state.
Accessible without authentication (all values are non-sensitive metrics).

Kernel health and diagnostics.
Returns the Kernel's internal state, component status, and uptime.
Bypasses all middlewares so it is always reachable.

Returns all available test types and their reference ranges.
Cached in-memory for 5 minutes to reduce database load.
